name: moongames
description: Portable MoonGames game packages sharing one Nakama backend.

scripts.build:web: pnpm build:chess && pnpm catalog:generate && pnpm --filter @moongames/launcher build && node tools/assemble-web.mjs
scripts.test:lua: lua Chess/server/test/chess_rules_test.lua && lua Chess/server/test/chess_protocol_test.lua && lua Chess/server/test/chess_match_test.lua && lua Chess/server/test/chess_profile_test.lua
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:lua && pnpm test:tools
